selection: up to8/source ascending SHA256 fixed prefix+URL, after known test/Oct14 development/historical report URL exclusion; no accepted flag used
scope: Snippet-level explicit free AI service, developer benefit/cloud free resource, credit/trial/giveaway/promo lead. Ordinary paid pricing, troubleshooting, feature announcement or ordinary open-source project release without an explicit offered benefit excluded. Unclear evidence null. Availability and personal eligibility never inferred.
limits: Bounded cached public sample, not platform-wide recall.
Eight per source cap creates a stratified sample, not deployment prevalence.
Observed snapshot time does not prove live availability.
Known URL overlap excluded; unknown historical semantic overlap cannot be ruled out.
Snippet truth uncertainty must remain null, never forced to pass.
A future fix informed by this sample makes it development data, not a new independent acceptance set.
